card.name: Mopacho
card.profile: Mopacho is a Congolese full-body dance that, per French Wikipedia, was created in Ouenze in the 5th arrondissement of Brazzaville by Zagala Mboyo, alias Sixte Singha, in 1990, inspired by the Mbochi dances of Boundji (Cuvette department). It engages the head, neck, shoulders, torso, hips and limbs in continuous motion - arms crossed in an 'X,' gentle hip rotations and a gradually lowering pelvis. It went viral in the early 2020s via TikTok, especially after DJ Afara Tsena's 2022 hit 'Afro Mbokalisation,' and was adopted by stars such as Fally Ipupa, Serge Beynaud and Gaz Mawete.
card.insight: Often described as 'sculpture in motion,' mopacho became a defining viral dance of Francophone Africa in 2024 and a point of Congolese cultural pride, prompting a national competition (Wikipedia; Afrocritik).
